items.quote: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel
items.claim: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders of Israel ascended
items.actor: Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel

items.quote: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness
items.claim: The group saw God with a sapphire-like paved surface and heaven-like appearance beneath God's feet
items.mechanism: paved work of a sapphire stone, and the body of heaven in his clearness
